narrative.summary: On a chilly North Atlantic ocean liner voyage, Neville Fairweather is found stabbed in his cabin. Witnesses insist they saw him alive and well on the first-class promenade deck twenty minutes past eight at night, but the ship's crew logs show the deck steward, Ferdinand Carrick, left the crew quarters only ten minutes past eight. The detective, Katherine Bellamy, uncovers that the victim was impersonated by the steward exploiting strict class segregation and social expectations, hiding the real time and place of death. The truth emerges through contradictions in uniform fabric, crew movement logs, and witness statements.

accepted_facts: Neville Fairweather was stabbed to death with a dagger to the heart.
Witnesses saw a man resembling Neville on the first-class promenade deck at twenty minutes past eight at night.
The steward, Ferdinand Carrick, left the crew quarters at ten minutes past eight according to the official log.
A torn inch and a half edge of uniform fabric was found snagged on Neville's cabin doorframe.
The steward's uniform fabric matches the torn fabric on the doorframe.
Ferdinand Carrick had motive and opportunity to kill Neville.
Other suspects have alibis overlapping the actual time of death.
inferred_conclusions: The man seen on the promenade deck was an impersonation by Ferdinand Carrick.
Neville Fairweather was already dead by the time of the promenade deck sighting.
The torn fabric on the cabin doorframe proves the steward's presence at the victim's cabin.
Ferdinand Carrick's alibi fails to cover the actual time of death.
The deception relied on witness cognitive bias and social logic to misidentify the impersonator as Neville.

mechanism.description: Ferdinand Carrick exploited the strict class segregation and social expectations aboard the ocean liner by impersonating Neville Fairweather on the first-class promenade deck. Witnesses, conditioned to expect Neville in his customary attire and mannerisms, were deceived by Carrick wearing a steward's uniform modified to appear like Neville’s typical clothing. The torn uniform fabric snagged on the victim’s cabin doorframe and the steward's logbook entries create a quantitative contradiction in timing proving the impersonation. The actual time of death was ten minutes past eight at night, earlier than the promenade deck sighting at twenty minutes past eight, which was staged.

delivery_path.step: Ferdinand Carrick leaves crew quarters at ten minutes past eight.
Carrick dons an altered steward's uniform to resemble Neville.
Carrick impersonates Neville on the promenade deck twenty minutes past eight.
Carrick kills Neville in the cabin before the promenade sighting.
The torn fabric snagged on the cabin doorframe during the struggle.

outcome.result: The deception is revealed by quantitative contradiction between the steward's log and witness sightings, the torn uniform fabric evidence, and the failed alibi of Ferdinand Carrick, proving his guilt.

false_assumption.statement: The man seen on the first-class promenade deck at twenty minutes past eight was Neville Fairweather himself.

false_assumption.what_it_hides: That the person was an impersonator, the steward Ferdinand Carrick, who exploited witness cognitive bias and the strict class segregation to mask the real time and place of death.

supporting_points: Dr. Ashgrove had a strong motive due to a recent professional dispute with Neville.

discriminating_test.design: Arrange a controlled observation comparing the crew logbook timestamps with witness statements and uniform fabric samples to prove the steward’s impersonation by quantitatively demonstrating the impossibility of the steward being both in the crew quarters and on the promenade deck at the times claimed. This includes forensic fabric comparison and eyewitness identification under guided conditions.
discriminating_test.knowledge_revealed: The test reveals the timing contradiction and fabric match already deduced, eliminating all innocent suspects and proving Ferdinand Carrick's guilt beyond doubt.
discriminating_test.pass_condition: The steward’s alibi fails under log and fabric evidence, and witnesses confirm the impersonation under scrutiny.
